# `akb init .` at a repository root: the target IS the repository, so the
# refusal reports that membership and carries the repo-root layout warning.
# --force addresses the layout only; a versioning mode is still required.

env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=user.name
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=ambient
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=user.email
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=ambient@local

mkdir host
cd host
exec git init -q

exec bash -c 'akb init .; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout '^akb-exit=2$'
stderr '^usage: host is a git repository — choose how the KB is versioned:$'
stderr '^  --embed    the KB joins this repository''s history; akb commits only its own paths \(kb/, raw/, \.agent-kb/\), never other worktree changes$'
stderr '^  --no-git   the KB is not versioned; akb excludes it from the host''s git status via \.git/info/exclude \(local to this clone\)$'
stderr '^This will write \.agent-kb/, kb/ and raw/ directly to the repo root\. --force if desired, otherwise prefer a subdirectory: akb init <name> --embed\.$'
! stderr 'internal:'
! exists .agent-kb

# --force addresses the layout warning only: it chooses no versioning mode,
# so the refusal stands unchanged.
exec bash -c 'akb init . --force; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout '^akb-exit=2$'
stderr '^usage: host is a git repository — choose how the KB is versioned:$'
! exists .agent-kb

# A mode plus --force initializes the base at the repository root and records
# it in the repository's history.
exec akb init . --embed --force
stdout '^Initialized KB "host" at .*/host$'
stdout '^kb: host is embedded inside repository .*; akb commits only kb/, raw/, \.agent-kb/$'
stdout '^commit identity: from git config \(ambient <ambient@local>\) — not recorded; each machine''s git identity applies$'
exists .agent-kb/akb.yaml
grep '^name: host$' .agent-kb/akb.yaml
grep '^versioning: git$' .agent-kb/akb.yaml
# This layout writes the ignore file of the base into the repository root.
exists .gitignore
grep '^\.agent-kb/search\.db\*$' .gitignore
exec git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^akb: init host$'

# An unversioned base at the repository root excludes the directories it owns
# instead, and leaves the root ignore file to the repository.
cd $WORK
mkdir host2
cd host2
exec git init -q

exec akb init . --no-git --force
stdout '^Initialized KB "host2" at .*/host2$'
stdout '^kb: excluded /\.agent-kb/, /kb/, /raw/ from host git tracking via \.git/info/exclude \(local to this clone; remove those lines to undo\)$'
! stdout 'commit identity'
grep '^versioning: none$' .agent-kb/akb.yaml
grep '^/\.agent-kb/$' .git/info/exclude
grep '^/kb/$' .git/info/exclude
grep '^/raw/$' .git/info/exclude
! exists .gitignore
# The base's own paths stay out of the repository's status.
exec git status --porcelain
! stdout .
